name: Mafuyu
source:
Favorite food: Milk, dairy products.
Disliked food: Food that tastes bitter.
Favorite things: Someone who will hold you.
Hate things: Loneliness.
Hobbies: Doing her best to be praised by her master.
Special skill: Failing.
